display.purpose: Not used on Biblioteca, Templates, or Integrações — those titles share Headline with the dashboard.

headline.purpose: Dashboard, login, Biblioteca, Templates, and Integrações (fp-h1). Editor document title is 700, clamp 24–34px; paper title is 600, clamp 20–28px.

title.purpose: Workspace document rows at 16px / 600; report ### / steps / alerts at 13px / 600 — all JetBrains Mono.

body.purpose: Running prose on IBM Plex Sans 14px; form fields 12px. Not titles.

label.purpose: Eyebrows and ## / tmpl-label (10px / 0.12em), index title and entries, badges (9px), field captions (0.08em) — JetBrains Mono.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: Normative. Cards, dialogs, menus, toasts, buttons, and the report stay flat. The template color-picker panel is the only overlay with a drop shadow — do not copy it.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Color and border transitions on hover (buttons, rows, rail, template cards).

motion.name: dialog-open
motion.purpose: Dialog fade + zoom-in-95. No shadow accompaniment.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The only filled action stamp. Chart Ink, square, 28px, JetBrains Mono.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 28px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid #1A2847; border-radius: 0; background: #1A2847; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.025em; line-height: 1; box-shadow: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #1A2847 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #1A2847; box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #1A2847; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Voided stamp: Paper fill, Hairline border, Ink type. Hover draws Chart Ink.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 28px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid #DEDEDE; border-radius: 0; background: #FFFFFF; color: #111111; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.025em; line-height: 1; box-shadow: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #1A2847; color: #1A2847; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #1A2847; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet stamp for secondary chrome. No fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 28px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid #DEDEDE; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #6B6B6B; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.025em; line-height: 1; box-shadow: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #1A2847; color: #1A2847; background: transparent; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #1A2847; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Instrument face: square, Input Stroke, Chart Ink border on focus, no ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; min-width: 220px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6B6B6B; } .ds-input { height: 28px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #D4D4D4; border-radius: 0; background: #FFFFFF; color: #111111; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; box-shadow: none; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #A3A3A3; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #D4D4D4; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #1A2847; box-shadow: none; } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #DC2626; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Primary surface: Hairline box with a 3px Chart Ink bar on top. No shadow.
components.css: .ds-stat { min-width: 160px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #DEDEDE; border-top: 3px solid #1A2847; border-radius: 0; background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: none; } .ds-stat-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 12px; color: #A3A3A3; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-stat-value { display: block; color: #111111; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Type Chip
components.description: Outlined stamp, never a filled pill. Type ink in the letters only.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid #DEDEDE; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; padding: 3px 6px; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-chip-report { color: #007F70; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #007F70; }

components.name: Rail Nav
components.description: 48px instrument rail. 36px square icon stamps; active is a Chart Ink wash, not a pill.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; width: 48px; padding: 10px 0; background: #F7F7F7; } .ds-rail-link { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #6B6B6B; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-rail-link:hover { background: #EFEFEF; color: #181818; } .ds-rail-link:focus-visible { outline: none; background: #F0F2F7; color: #1A2847; } .ds-rail-link-active { background: color-mix(in srgb, #1A2847 12%, transparent); color: #1A2847; }

components.name: Brand Mark
components.description: Three bars, −9deg: Chart Ink, Seal Wax, Compass Brass. The only place the three identity inks sit together.
components.css: .ds-brand { position: relative; display: inline-flex; width: 22px; height: 22px; transform: rotate(-9deg); } .ds-brand i { position: absolute; display: block; width: 8px; border-radius: 1px; } .ds-brand i:nth-child(1) { height: 17px; left: 1px; top: 3px; background: #1A2847; } .ds-brand i:nth-child(2) { height: 13px; left: 8px; top: 1px; background: #8B2735; } .ds-brand i:nth-child(3) { height: 10px; left: 15px; top: 9px; background: #C5A572; }

narrative.overview:
Portulan is a portolan chart for technical writing: bearings, ink, and paper. The workspace is a gazette of instruments, not a SaaS dashboard. Density is that of a tool: 14px body, 1px rules, no ornament. Personality is JetBrains Mono — the instrument face of chrome, report titles, section labels, steps, and code — together with the three-bar brand mark (Chart Ink, Seal Wax, Compass Brass) and the 3px navy-to-burgundy rule under the header. IBM Plex Sans is the reading face for sentences on the paper, not the product voice.

The system is editorial ink. Hierarchy is typeset, not decorated. Burgundy eyebrows and teal section numbers are the gazette’s running heads; they are rare on purpose. Soft-SaaS (rounded-lg, card shadows, focus rings, glass, marketing gradients) and default shadcn (8px radius, 3px rings, shadow-sm) are anti-references even though the primitives sit on that library. New screens inherit the chart, not the kit.

Two registers, one world. The authenticated workspace is tool chrome: hairlines, stamps, a 48px rail. The report is reading paper on screen (a web sheet, not A4) and print paper in PDF (A4). Do not dress the editor chrome like a magazine, and do not dress the report like an app shell.
keyCharacteristics: Square stamps: every control, card, and dialog is radius 0.
Hairline structure: depth is a 1px rule and a tonal wash, never a drop shadow.
Two tokens, two jobs: JetBrains Mono (--font-mono) is the product face — titles, labels, badges, tabs, buttons, stats, and code. IBM Plex Sans (--font-sans) is running prose only.
Chart Ink is the only action fill; Seal Wax and Compass Brass are identity, not buttons.
A 3px identity rule: Chart Ink → Seal Wax under the header and editor top bar; solid Chart Ink on stat cards and integration panels.
Instrument chrome is 28px tall (`--control-height`). Rail icons stay 36×36 inside a 48px rail.
Light paper is canonical; dark remaps the same inks (it is not a second brand).

rules.name: The Seal Wax Rule
rules.body: Seal Wax appears as eyebrow, selection, and the brand’s middle bar. It is never the fill of a primary action.

rules.name: The Chart Ink Rule
rules.body: Chart Ink is the only action fill. Solid 3px bars on stats and integration panels are Chart Ink; the header/editor identity rule is Chart Ink into Seal Wax. Teal, coral, purple, and indigo enumerate and accent; they do not compete for the button.

rules.name: The Two-Token Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is the product face. IBM Plex Sans is running prose. Titles, ## labels, steps, alerts, the index (title and entries), badges, tabs, buttons, stats, and code use Mono. Do not treat system-ui or ui-monospace as the designed face on .report-paper — that is what made the preview look like SF Pro.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Workspace content maxes at 1100px (dashboard 1380px). Report reading on screen is full-bleed in its pane. Print/PDF maxes at A4. Leads stay inside ~64ch.

rules.name: The Hairline Structure Rule
rules.body: Depth is border and tone. Never introduce a drop shadow, even on overlays or on the report. If a surface must read as “on top,” use a 1px Hairline against Paper, or a 3px identity bar (Chart Ink on stats/panels, type-ink on document rows).

rules.name: The Square Stamp Rule
rules.body: Radius is 0. If a control looks friendly, it is wrong.

dos: Do set radius to 0 and borders to 1px Hairline on every new control, card, and overlay.
Do keep JetBrains Mono as the product face (chrome, report titles, `##` labels, the index, code) and IBM Plex Sans for running prose only.
Do use Chart Ink as the only filled primary action; keep the 3px header rule as Chart Ink → Seal Wax and the 3px card/panel bars as solid Chart Ink.
Do stamp chrome at 28px (`--control-height`) unless the control is explicitly lg (40px) or xs (24px).
Do treat Seal Wax as eyebrow/selection/brand, Sounding Teal Ink as enumeration, Compass Brass as identity.
Do keep workspace measure at 1100px (dashboard 1380px), report reading full-bleed in its pane on screen, and A4 only in print/PDF.
Do write product UI in Portuguese (pt-BR), technical and direct — labels in mono where the chrome already does.
Do remap the same inks in `.dark` (Chart Ink Inverse on filled actions, lifted navy on the brand bars) without inventing a second palette.
donts: Don't use rounded-lg, pills, glass, marketing gradients, or drop shadows on chrome (Soft-SaaS). The color-picker thumbs and its panel shadow stay where they are; they are not a license for menus or dialogs.
Don't ship default shadcn look: 8px radius, 3px focus rings, `shadow-sm` / `shadow-md`.
Don't fill a primary button with Seal Wax, teal, coral, purple, or gold.
Don't put Plex Sans on tabs, badges, or report titles, or let `system-ui` / `ui-monospace` become the face of `.report-paper`.
Don't swap JetBrains Mono for Geist, Inter, IBM Plex Mono, or a system-only stack, and don't add a third family.
Don't dress the editor chrome like a magazine, or the report like an app shell.
Don't force A4 (210mm) or a 46rem column on the editor preview or public reading sheet; that print geometry is PDF only, and screen paper fills its pane.
Don't invent testimonials, client logos, or decorative illustration; identity is the three bars and the inks.
